bear_assumptions: EUR 105 million forward revenue at 1.5x EV/revenue plus EUR 13.208 million net cash over 31.157845 million shares; defense awards convert slowly, margins reverse, working capital consumes cash and financing dilutes holders.
base_assumptions: EUR 120 million forward revenue at 2.25x EV/revenue plus EUR 13.208 million net cash over 31.157845 million shares; H1 growth moderates, gross margin stays near 50%, programs convert, and cash conversion and dilution remain imperfect.
bull_assumptions: EUR 135 million forward revenue at 3.25x EV/revenue plus EUR 13.208 million net cash over 31.157845 million shares; European and NATO demand scales, repeat deliveries expand margins, and financing avoids material per-share dilution.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a refreshed primary-evidence valuation clears the margin-of-safety, expected-return, base-upside, payoff and liquidity gates; downgrade if awards fail to convert, recurring profit reverses, working-capital burn persists, partner funding tightens or dilution destroys per-share value.
